evidence_rules.indexed_title: Candidate subject evidence only; preserve exact original and source.
evidence_rules.native_caption: Evidence of caption text, not proof of spoken language or technical correctness.
evidence_rules.transcript: Requires genuine obtained subtitle/transcript, source, access basis and automatic/manual status.
evidence_rules.language: Separate metadata text language estimate from audio language; no inference from creator region, query language or hashtag alone.
evidence_rules.rights: Software license and provider access do not license third-party video or verbatim captions.
evidence_rules.counts: Keep raw, unique, new, accepted, editorially reviewed, French-text and transcript counts separate.
